title: A primitive diagonal compact circle embeds in K and misses its center

diagonal_circle.generators: E=e1e2 in the first Spin(7) factor and F=e3e4 in the second, with E^2=F^2=-1.
diagonal_circle.closure: At beta+2 pi both lifted factors acquire -1, so the pair changes by diagonal(-1,-1) and defines a 2 pi-periodic loop in K.
diagonal_circle.embedding: The class is the identity only when both lifted factors are the same scalar sign, which occurs only at beta=0 modulo 2 pi.
diagonal_circle.center_intersection: A D point is central only when both lifted exponentials are scalar; the two endpoint lifts have equal signs and both represent the identity, so D intersection Z(K)={1}.
diagonal_circle.half_period: D(pi) is noncentral and is not z=[-1,1].

claim_ceiling: The explicitly defined diagonal loop is a primitive embedded circle in the repository control K and meets Z(K) trivially. No source or physical action selects it.
